name: prd-pr-cursor
description: Cursor variant of the workshop dev workflow — orchestrator rules plus helper subagents (code-explorer, code-architect, plan-reviewer, impl-backend, impl-frontend, impl-simplify, test-plan-walker) driving the 10-phase plan-then-build flow with vertical-slice architecture and an end-to-end test-plan walkthrough. Agents use Cursor's .md format; the orchestrator ships as a .mdc rules file.
